name: houdini-tools
description: Houdini toolkit including command-line tools, installation path detection, and a bgeo/USD MCP server

interface.shortDescription: Houdini CLI, locator, environment, and lightweight scene inspection tools
interface.longDescription: Bundles Houdini command-line workflows, installation discovery, Houdini environment references, node help authoring, and a lightweight MCP server for inspecting bgeo and USD files without loading Houdini geometry.
defaultPrompt: 用 houdini-locator 找 Houdini 安裝路徑
用 houdini-cli 檢查 Houdini 命令列工具
用 houdini-lite 檢查 bgeo 或 USD 檔案
用 houdini-node-help 撰寫節點說明文件
